thread:
Ashley: heads up — strict-validate canary (0.2) started this morning and we're seeing a spike of schema rejects on /invoke. dashboard shows a cluster of requests routed to fallback 'degen'.
Jae: saw it in eu-west. bulk of rejects claim "missing field: tool_response.tool_id" on fncall flows.
Sam: short context — SDK v1.4 made tool_id required in fncall. older clients (v1.2/1.3) don't send it. the canary picked strict validation for ~10% traffic but tag matching overlapped with legacy clients.
Kevin: quick telemetry question — are these validation rejects producing billing events? I can already see quota decrements for some accounts that later fell back.
deploy-bot: canary update applied: /invoke strict-validate=0.2 at 2026-03-21T14:02:13Z by @Ashley
Ashley: log snippet from failing request: 
```
ERROR validate: request_id=abcd-1234 user=acct-999 path=/invoke reason="missing field: tool_response.tool_id" body={"tool_response": {"output": "..."}}
route_fallback=degen
```
Jae: looks like validator is rejecting pre-routing, before we materialize handshake/client_sdk metadata. that's why lots of legit legacy traffic trips it.
Sam: root cause suspicion: strict validation runs on initial parse. we only attach route/client metadata later in the router. options: 1) delay strict validation until after handshake resolution, 2) add permissive exception for client_sdk < 1.4.
Kevin: console UX problem — dashboard shows a big red spike for "schema rejects" but no breakdown by client SDK or fallback counts. ops is paged repeatedly.
Ashley: immediate mitigation: pause the canary, apply an exception to accept missing tool_id when client_sdk < 1.4, and surface a console link to the rollback toggle in the incident banner.
Jae: drafted rollback PR + exception: https://git.company/repo/pull/4321 (internal).
Sam: follow-ups: 1) move strict validation check to run post-handshake in router pipeline, 2) add telemetry tags: validation.contract_version and client_sdk.version, 3) add metric: validation_reject_to_fallback_rate per route, 4) ensure quota/billing attribution only occurs after final route decision.
Kevin: I can own dashboard panels and quota attribution fix. Sam / Jae can push validator changes. Ashley can lead customer comms and the postmortem.
Ashley: running a backfill query to find affected accounts: 
```
SELECT account_id, count() AS rejects
FROM events
WHERE event_type='validation.reject' AND path='/invoke' AND ts >= toUnixTimestamp(now()-INTERVAL 12 HOUR)
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY rejects DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Jae: I'll run that and DM top owners + collect sample request_ids.
deploy-bot: canary paused: /invoke strict-validate rolled to 0.0 at 2026-03-21T14:18:50Z by @Jae
Ashley: creating incident ticket and postmortem template; leaving thread open until PR merged.
Sam: one more ask — add an alert in console that surfaces reject->fallback delta (i.e., are rejects actually causing fallbacks) so we don't get noisy alarms in future.
Kevin: noted. will add panel + alert and make quota attribution idempotent.
Ashley: thanks team. will update customers with a short note once we have backfill and owners list.
